description: This file defines the code-behind for the AdminCourseQueue ASP.NET WebForms page, handling events such as page load, button clicks for navigation, and GridView selection changes within the Admin Queue interface of the online examination system.

classes.name: AdminCourseQueue
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the AdminCourseQueue ASP.NET WebForm, managing UI events and page logic.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for profile button click event. Currently empty.
